title: Naval Combat / Trading  Game
author: PhotoDisastrous8275
selftext:
I've been working on this for about 1 month now and still have a long way to go but wanted to show my progress. Any feedback is welcomed although I know I'm not showing much.

Currently In the game.  
\- Fast travel  
\- Procedural Island with Local Prices.  
\- Trade between islands  
\- Ship Combat / Boarding.  
\- Ship Inventory.

I'm not trying to make a triple A game just an enjoyable experience.
